meta.name: solidity-security
meta.description: Master smart contract security best practices to prevent common vulnerabilities and implement secure Solidity patterns. Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在编写或审计区块链合约,担心出现安全漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Write smart contracts that resist common security exploits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or auditing blockchain contracts and worry about vulnerabilities

howto.what: 写或审计 Solidity 合约时,Claude 会按安全开发模式检查重入、整数溢出、访问控制等漏洞,并产出 Hardhat 安全测试示例和带 NatSpec 注释的合约代码。
howto.when: 当你要编写智能合约、审计已有合约,或为区块链应用实现安全措施时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这份合约有没有重入漏洞
say.note: 会指出风险点并给出修复写法

say.text: 用 CEI 模式重写这个 withdraw 函数
say.note: 按检查-生效-交互顺序改写

say.text: 为我的合约写一份 Hardhat 安全测试
say.note: 覆盖重入、溢出、权限三类用例

howto.what_en: When writing or auditing Solidity contracts, Claude applies security patterns to check reentrancy, integer overflow, and access control issues, and produces Hardhat security tests plus NatSpec-documented contract code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.

say_en.text: Check this contract for reentrancy vulnerabilities
say_en.note: Points out risks and shows fixed code

say_en.text: Rewrite this withdraw function using the CEI pattern
